adjudication.rationale: In `embeddable-host` component `save()` sets `props.category_id = this.get('categoryId')`, which can be `null` when the user doesn’t choose a category. Server-side (`Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#save_host`) then defaults blank `category_id` to `SiteSetting.uncategorized_category_id` and returns the saved record. However, the client `then()` handler unconditionally does `host.set('category', Discourse.Category.findById(this.get('categoryId')));` which becomes `findById(null)` → `undefined`, overwriting any existing/embedded category and causing the UI (`{{category-badge host.category}}`) to show no category until a reload/hydration fixes it.
